description:
What this task is actually trying to accomplish — kept separate
from WorkPacket itself so "the goal" and "the guardrails around
achieving it" (scope/tool/budget/approval policies) are independently
readable and independently testable.

extensions.description: Namespaced vendor/runtime-specific metadata, keyed by a short vendor identifier (e.g. 'anthropic', 'langgraph'). Never required, never interpreted by this codebase's own workflow engine — purely a passthrough for a concrete runtime integration. Must never contain secrets (tokens, keys, passwords) — see test_no_contract_field_is_secret_shaped.
extensions.title: Extensions

goal.description: A single, concrete statement of what a completed task should have achieved.
goal.title: Goal

non_goals.description: Explicitly out of scope — mirrors the existing 'Out of Scope' section convention (see STORY_LLD_SECTIONS, Phase 00 baseline appendix).
non_goals.title: Non Goals

success_definition.description: How a resolver/human should recognize the goal was met — distinct from acceptance_criteria, which are individually checkable sub-conditions.
success_definition.title: Success Definition
